observations.why: The verb 'adopting' frames a new tool as a chosen change, appealing to novelty and self-direction.
The performance claim appeals to mastery and capability (competence) and competitive achievement (self-enhancement) as the goods.
The commissive commitment to a scheduled migration appeals to stability and orderly planning rather than immediate disruption.
The summary restates the performance gain as an improvement, appealing to capability and quality of craft.
